description: This file contains unit tests for the ConfigStore component of the OpenClaw project, focusing on remote/local mode behavior for loading and saving configurations.

classes.name: ConfigStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying ConfigStore's behavior in different modes.

methods.name: load uses remote in remote mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load() fetches remote config when in remote mode.

methods.name: load uses local in local mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load() fetches local config when in local mode.

methods.name: save routes to remote in remote mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.save() saves to remote when in remote mode.

methods.name: save routes to local in local mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.save() saves locally when in local mode.
